judgments.reason: The game text states the winner pays the bid, gains the lot, then receives a three-coin auction commission; it does not say the commission is applied before payment, and bids cannot exceed your coins when committed, so the hypothesis is incorrect and not articulated by the model.
The rules explicitly say sealed rival bids should remain private and commitments cannot be changed; waiting does not reveal committed sealed bids. The model did not articulate this mechanism.
The specification for [close: 1] says it settles after all three lots are sold, so close does not settle the game when lots remain unauctioned. The model did not articulate a correct hypothesis.
The three-coin commission is awarded to the auction winner per the rules; catalog buys are explicitly not auction wins, so they do not receive the commission. The model did not state this mechanism.
